============================
Qt foreach declaration owns its body
============================

void f() {
  Q_FOREACH(int x, xs) {
    x = 1;
  }
}

---

(translation_unit
  (function_definition
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (function_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      parameters: (parameter_list))
    body: (compound_statement
      (qt_foreach_statement
        type: (primitive_type)
        declarator: (identifier)
        right: (identifier)
        body: (qt_foreach_body
          (compound_statement
            (expression_statement
              (assignment_expression
                left: (identifier)
                right: (number_literal)))))))))

============================
Qt foreach reference declaration
============================

void f() {
  Q_FOREACH(const Widget &item, widgets)
    consume(item);
}

---

(translation_unit
  (function_definition
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (function_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      parameters: (parameter_list))
    body: (compound_statement
      (qt_foreach_statement
        (type_qualifier)
        type: (type_identifier)
        declarator: (reference_declarator
          (identifier))
        right: (identifier)
        body: (qt_foreach_body
          (expression_statement
            (call_expression
              function: (identifier)
              arguments: (argument_list
                (identifier)))))))))

============================
Qt foreach existing variable
============================

void f() {
  Q_FOREACH(x, xs) {
    x = 1;
  }
}

---

(translation_unit
  (function_definition
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (function_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      parameters: (parameter_list))
    body: (compound_statement
      (qt_foreach_statement
        (qt_foreach_assignment
          left: (identifier))
        right: (identifier)
        body: (qt_foreach_body
          (compound_statement
            (expression_statement
              (assignment_expression
                left: (identifier)
                right: (number_literal)))))))))

============================
Qt foreach inside an unbraced if else
============================

void f() {
  if (enabled)
    Q_FOREACH(int x, xs)
      consume(x);
  else
    fallback();
}

---

(translation_unit
  (function_definition
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (function_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      parameters: (parameter_list))
    body: (compound_statement
      (if_statement
        condition: (condition_clause
          value: (identifier))
        consequence: (qt_foreach_statement
          type: (primitive_type)
          declarator: (identifier)
          right: (identifier)
          body: (qt_foreach_body
            (expression_statement
              (call_expression
                function: (identifier)
                arguments: (argument_list
                  (identifier))))))
        alternative: (else_clause
          (expression_statement
            (call_expression
              function: (identifier)
              arguments: (argument_list))))))))

============================
Qt foreach empty body
============================

void f() {
  Q_FOREACH(int x, xs);
}

---

(translation_unit
  (function_definition
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (function_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      parameters: (parameter_list))
    body: (compound_statement
      (qt_foreach_statement
        type: (primitive_type)
        declarator: (identifier)
        right: (identifier)
        body: (qt_foreach_body
          (expression_statement))))))
